transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?

Hi. Um... I came in because I just can't stop feeling like everything that goes wrong is my fault. It's... I just constantly feel like I'm a bad employee, and a bad homeowner. Like I honestly deserve to lose everything I've worked so hard for.
Along with feeling this way, have you been feeling consistently down, sad, or depressed lately?

Um... I'm not really sure if I'd use the word depressed. I haven't really noticed feeling sad or down, exactly. It's mostly just... what I was saying before. Just that constant heavy feeling that I'm doing a terrible job at work and ruining my house. I don't really feel sad, just... overwhelmed by the fact that I'm messing everything up.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy doing?

Yeah, I have. I used to do a lot of different things... I'd plan brunches, paint in my spare room, go hiking, and even sign up for networking events. But now... I don't know, those things just feel like tasks I’m pretending to care about. I just don't get anything out of them anymore.
About how long have you been experiencing this loss of interest and feeling like everything is your fault?
It's been a while. I think... yeah, the loss of interest and that feeling like I'm messing everything up have been with me for about two years and one month now.

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had normal stress before, but nothing like this. This is the first time it's been this bad and lasted this long.
Have you been experiencing low energy or feeling unusually tired or fatigued during this time?

Not really, no. I mean... physically, my energy is mostly fine. I'm not feeling unusually exhausted or anything like that. It's more just that I don't care to do things, rather than being too tired to do them.

{"intent": "Assess for changes in sleep patterns to evaluate for criteria of a depressive episode.", "question": "Have you noticed any changes in your sleep, such as having trouble falling asleep, waking up

Yeah, my sleep has been pretty bad. Most nights I just lie awake for hours, just... listening to the house settle. And then when I finally do fall asleep, I end up waking up around three or four in the morning. After that, I really can't get back to sleep before I have to get up for work.
{"intent": "Assess for changes in appetite or weight to evaluate diagnostic criteria for a depressive episode.", "question": "Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or your weight

Yeah, my appetite has been pretty all over the place. Mostly, I just end up skipping real meals during the day. I've been living on coffee, toast, and just... whatever is easiest to grab. I have noticed that my clothes are fitting a bit looser lately, so I guess I've lost some weight.
Have you found it harder to concentrate, focus on your work, or make everyday decisions?
Not really, no. I mean... my focus has been mostly fine. I haven't noticed any real trouble concentrating at work or making decisions, honestly. I'm still getting things done like normal.
During this period, have you had any thoughts of death, or thoughts of hurting yourself?
No, I haven't. I mean, I've been feeling pretty down and exhausted, but... no, I haven't had any thoughts about dying or hurting myself. Nothing like that.
